premise: The Sun sets on the base for a night that will last two weeks; the stars come out and don't twinkle, and everyone settles in.
inspiration: Perrault's 'Sleeping Beauty', where a whole castle sleeps for a hundred years, turned: a long sleep under the stars that nobody minds and nobody needs waking from.
lesson: The dark can be cosy when you're ready for it.
learning: A night on the Moon lasts about two weeks.

en-US.title: The Two-Week Night
en-US.text: [softly] On the Moon, a day lasts a long, long time. And so does the night. {canvas:nightfall} Slowly the light faded from the plain, and the long Moon night began. It would last two whole weeks. {all:pulse} Out at the base, everyone {all:shake 0.3} got ready. Lamps were checked. {all:glow 0.4} {all:hop} Batteries were full. Warm things were tucked in tight. {all:wobble} [curious] Did anyone mind the dark? {all:face happy} Not one bit. {canvas:milkyway} For out came the stars, more than anyone could count, and the pale band of the Milky Way stretched across the sky. {all:sparkle 0.6} They didn't twinkle. With no air to make them shimmer, they shone perfectly still. {all:pulse 0.4} And low over the ridge, the Earth glowed blue and white, like a night-light left on. {all:hearts} [yawns] One by one, everyone {all:face sleeping} {all:fade-out 0.4} settled down. {sfx:lullaby} [whispers] Two weeks of stars. Plenty of time for sweet dreams.

es-ES.title: La noche de dos semanas
es-ES.text: [softly] En la Luna, un día dura muchísimo. Y la noche, también. {canvas:nightfall} Poco a poco se apagó la luz de la llanura, y empezó la larga noche lunar. Duraría dos semanas enteras. {all:pulse} En la base, todos {all:shake 0.3} se prepararon. Se revisaron las lámparas. {all:glow 0.4} {all:hop} Las baterías estaban llenas. Todo lo calentito, bien arropado. {all:wobble} [curious] ¿Le importaba a alguien la oscuridad? {all:face happy} Ni un poquito. {canvas:milkyway} Porque salieron las estrellas, más de las que nadie podría contar, y la franja pálida de la Vía Láctea cruzó el cielo. {all:sparkle 0.6} No titilaban. Sin aire que las hiciera temblar, brillaban completamente quietas. {all:pulse 0.4} Y sobre las montañas, la Tierra brillaba azul y blanca, como una lamparita encendida. {all:hearts} [yawns] Uno a uno, todos {all:face sleeping} {all:fade-out 0.4} se acomodaron. {sfx:lullaby} [whispers] Dos semanas de estrellas. Tiempo de sobra para dulces sueños.
